cases.name: maximal spans per device
cases.why: head keeps the light layer 0 + embed, the tail pays lm_head + MTP + embed copy; whole-model devices have exactly [0, 48)

cases.name: join priority: holes first
cases.why: a hole beats raising a k=1 range

cases.name: join priority: k < k_min before capacity
cases.why: no hole: the single-holder half wins

cases.name: join priority: disk-warm among equals
cases.why: equal windows: the one on disk, zero download

cases.name: join priority: replicas stack on boundaries
cases.why: valley fill: the second copy of every span lands on the first copy's boundaries (whole-span backups exist)

cases.name: sticky rejoin, zero download
cases.why: a returning node goes home even when k=1 layers exist elsewhere

cases.name: rejoin closes a hole when its old span is redundant
cases.why: holes beat stickiness only if the old span keeps k_min without the node

cases.name: repair: hole timer, mover, make-before-break, damping
cases.why: a hole is repaired only after hole_repair_s by a node held k_min times; its old span counts until complete_move; one move in flight and one per move_interval_s

cases.name: repair: disk-warm mover first
cases.why: the mover with the target on disk wins (zero download)

cases.name: repair: k < k_min after kmin_repair_s
cases.why: only a node held k_min+1 times moves; nobody drops below k_min

cases.name: repair: a disk-warm rejoin preempts k_min repair
cases.why: the dead span's owner returns before the timer

cases.name: repair: no legal mover, no move
cases.why: nobody may drop a layer it alone holds
